written.headline: Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital
written.summary: Unacademy co‑founders Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini are raising a ₹700 crore venture fund, Longshot Capital, to back AI and deep‑tech startups. The fund aims to invest in 25‑28 seed and pre‑Series A companies with cheques of $500,000‑$1.5 million, targeting its first close in January 2027.
